$comment: What each real captured screen shows, read off the capture itself. Regions are in capture pixels at the 390px viewport width (y = top, h = height), and every label is a heading or text visible in that region. The director chooses shots by this; a region that no longer matches its capture is a guard failure, not a style choice.
